# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately, never in a public issue:
[open a private security advisory](https://github.com/damien-mathieu1/monkeyread/security/advisories/new).

Include what the problem is, how to reproduce it, and its impact.

## Rules

- Only test with your own account, never with other people's data.
- No denial of service, spam or large-scale automated testing.
- Do not keep or share any data obtained during your tests.

## What happens next

You will get an answer as soon as possible. monkeyread is a volunteer project with no bounty program, but fixed reports are credited if you wish.

## Supported versions

Only the version deployed at [monkeyread.dmathieu.dev](https://monkeyread.dmathieu.dev) (the `main` branch) is supported.
